source.title: Pamidronate Rescue Therapy for Hypercalcemia in a Child With Williams Syndrome.

confirmation.summary: FISH showed a 7q11.23 deletion including the elastin gene.
evidence: confirmed by FISH probe analysis which revealed a deletion at 7q11.23 encompassing the elastin gene

note.text: Since he was six months old, our baby has not been gaining weight, has been fussy and cranky, and has been constipated. At fifteen months he is small and thin, and his weight, length and head size are all well below the charts. People say his face looks a bit unusual. Blood tests showed far too much calcium, a kidney scan showed calcium deposits, and a heart scan found a mild narrowing just above a heart valve.
note.author: Peter's Kiro, written from the article's findings; not the parent's words
